neet_phy_u04_t06_1.working: Work done by air resistance depends on the path taken and is always dissipative, so air resistance is non-conservative. Gravitational, electrostatic and ideal spring forces are conservative.

neet_phy_u04_t06_2.working: Friction f = μmg = 0.2×5×10 = 10 N. It always opposes motion, so it does negative work on both legs. Total path = 8 m, so W = -10×8 = -80 J.

neet_phy_u04_t06_4.working: A is true because kinetic friction is non-conservative, so no potential energy function exists for it. R is false because friction does negative, non-zero work around a closed path.

neet_phy_u04_t06_5.working: Statement I is incorrect: the correct relation is W_c = -ΔU = U_i - U_f. Statement II is incorrect: gravity is conservative, so its work between two fixed points is path-independent.
